selected.source:
{{
if you.race() == "Mummy" then
    return "velvet-covered"
elseif you.mutation('beak') > 0 then
    return "pearl-beaked"
elseif you.transform() == "death" then
    return "well-preserved"
elseif you.transform() == "statue" then
    return "marble-toed"
elseif you.transform() == "dragon" then
    return "opal-scaled"
elseif you.race() == "Felid" then
    return "pillow-pawed"
elseif you.race() == "Octopode" then
    return "soft-tentacled"
elseif you.race() == "Formicid" then
    return "massive-mandibled"
elseif you.race() == "Poltergeist" then
    return "high-spirited"
elseif you.race() == "Revenant" then
    return "ivory-boned"
else
    return "rosy-lipped"
end
}}
